name: @duke-dsh-plugins/dsh-remote-control
description: Remote-control bridge for DeepSeek Harness: pairs a HarmonyOS phone app with the desktop Host over an end-to-end-encrypted public relay (WebSocket). Lets the phone list/create/switch sessions, send prompts, watch streamed replies, cancel turns, and answer approval and ask-user-question requests from anywhere; pushes Huawei Push Kit notifications (gracefully disabled when AGC is unconfigured) for approvals, questions, and turn completion. Fail-open by design: any relay timeout or fault hands the request back to the desktop answerer.
